regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad but shallow theme rotation (50% eligible, absorption 0.31) led by precious metals (Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners) with durable momentum bars (0.69/0.73) and no crowding on the leader. Trend-gate discipline is validated here (gate_helps true), so the absolute-trend leg is worth honoring as a de-risking signal, but cross-sectional rank carries no return edge and track_record directional accuracy is weak (0.312), so convictions will be low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the precious-metals complex (Silver & Royalties + Gold Miners) loses its durability edge: if the leader's durability_bar drops below 0.55 or breadth falls below 0.7 while Gold then Silver both break below their 20-day moving averages, the leadership handoff would be treated as confirmed and the overweight lean retired.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the prevailing leader with the top durability_bar (0.69), full breadth (1.0), and is eligible and scorable via XGD.TO. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market, so respecting the trend leg while it is eligible is defensible as a drawdown-aware tilt, not a return forecast. Crowding is absent (crowded false, z 0.8), so no size-down caution applies to the leader.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mixed, not trending, and the rotation margin over Gold Miners is razor-thin (0.034) — leadership is unstable and could reverse without warning; relative momentum has no predictive edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 20-day low while still above the absolute-trend threshold before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is a very close challenger (score 2.093 vs 2.127 leader) with an even slightly higher durability_bar (0.73) and full breadth, also eligible and unscored-crowded. The overlap in proxy (XGD.TO) with Silver & Royalties means these are practically the same trade; treating them as one precious-metals complex is cleaner than trying to separate them. No crowding flag.
theses.dissent: Margin to the leader is negligible and both are mixed Hurst — there is no momentum reason to prefer Gold over Silver; the whole complex is one narrative and could peak together on a single macro shift.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% total return before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is eligible and ranked 4th but is the only crowded theme in the eligible set (crowded true, crowding_z 1.29). Under the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade or short — so the appropriate expression is 'avoid adding' rather than a bearish lean. The crowded tag is a legitimate reason to stand aside on new exposure while the theme remains eligible.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge in the backtests — being crowded is not a return signal and the theme could keep grinding higher with energy tailwinds; avoiding costs upside, it does not protect against it.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO makes a new 60-day high with crowding_z falling below 1.0 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
